title: Fourier granularity of a path expansion
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, and let a finite list of paths on the $n$-coordinate binary cube have real outputs. Suppose each path in the list has length at most $k$ and has an integer output. Then every Fourier coefficient of the sign-cube function associated with the sum of the paths' outputs times their path indicators is an integer multiple of $2^{-k}$.
